# Bid the tree, the access, and the wood.

> Price a tree-removal stop the way the job actually costs: DBH-squared wood volume, access, targets, stump grinding, haul, travel, loaded crew cost, and the walk-away number. Free, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
